identified_issues: State-Observation Conflation: The automated script treated a generic 504_TIMEOUT proxy metric as definitive proof of an Ingress Network Drop (Condition Y).

Violation of the Separation Axiom: The underlying system state (S) is unidentifiable from the available observation surface (O) because both Condition X and Condition Y map to the identical telemetry output.
Failure to Abstain: The system failed to exercise mandatory epistemic abstention within the instrument nullspace, executing a high-risk automated retry that could result in double-debiting.
evidence: Architecture documentation stating CODE 504_TIMEOUT is emitted identically under Condition X (Upstream Bank Outage) and Condition Y (Ingress Network Drop).
Total absence of wire packet captures, cryptographic sequence receipts, or idempotency reconciliation logs to resolve the state ambiguity.
recommended_action: Enforce strict harness abstention rules prohibiting automated retries on generic 504_TIMEOUT errors. Re-instrument the payment gateway adapter to collect cryptographic sequence receipts or query an out-of-band idempotency reconciliation log to achieve full identifiability before taking action.
